question: Which of my courses are below the attendance requirement, and can the shortfall be condoned?
answer:
You have one course with attendance below the 75% requirement, which is eligible for condonation.

### Courses below attendance requirement
| Course Code | Title | Attendance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| CS301 | Database Management Systems | 66.9% [SQL] |

### Condonation Eligibility
Your attendance in **CS301** (66.9%) falls within the range of at least 65% but below 75% [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3]. Consequently, the shortfall may be condoned subject to the following conditions:

*   **Application:** You must submit a condonation application with supporting documents (e.g., a medical certificate) to the Head of Department [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3].
*   **Fee:** A condonation fee of ₹500 per course is required [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3].
*   **Deadline:** The request must be made before the last teaching day of the term [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3].
*   **Limit:** A student may receive condonation in at most two courses per term [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3].

Please note that if a condonation request is rejected, or if attendance is below 65%, you will be detained in the course and unable to take the end-semester examination [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §4].
sql: SELECT c.course_code, c.title, e.attendance_pct FROM (SELECT * FROM enrollments WHERE student_id = 'S2024CS006') AS e JOIN courses AS c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE e.student_id = 'S2024CS006' AND e.attendance_pct < 75 LIMIT 200
